title: WHERE YOUR PAYCHECK ACTUALLY GOES
_doc: Dre, 2026-09-04: 'all videos need to be 15-20 sec long max and get to the point.' At ~150 words a minute that is a HARD ceiling of about 48 spoken words for the whole film. So the classical structure still holds (what / how / why, one problem, one solution) but each beat gets ONE sentence and the film carries exactly one number. Anything that needs a second number is a different video. Five shots: hook, the invisible slice, the reveal, the fix, the close.

shots.vo: You made three thousand this month. Can you say where it went?
shots.art: A candle character standing alone in a dim apartment at night, looking down at a phone in his hand, the screen the only bright thing in the room. Wide shot, he is small in the frame, the room large and quiet around him.

shots.vo: Rent and bills you can name. The rest disappears.
After everything, sixty dollars was left to save. Not because you chose sixty.
Take it first instead of last, and the same paycheck saves three hundred.
Set one transfer tonight. You cannot save what is left.
shots.art: A candle character sitting on the edge of a bed at night, phone held in both hands, the screen glowing warmly on his face. Calm and settled, the room dark around him.
